# CORE-DEC-02

**Is every open question named as a consideration, with who answers it and by when, or the design states it has none?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DEC: Decisions and open questions |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Reads | `considerations`, `considerations.owner`, `considerations.due` |

## Why it matters

R2 needs the open questions listed; an assessment that finds an unlisted one has found a consideration. A question with no owner or date stays open.
